images.prompt: Create an original production game terrain material for Ice Age Lord, matching the two attached existing reference paintings ONLY in their muted winter ink-painted palette and brush character. Produce a single overhead seamless square swatch of undisturbed dirty ivory winter snow. Flat material only: no perspective, horizon, buildings, trees, rocks, objects, text, UI, frames or directional cast shadows. Broad quiet value variation, medium softly wind-sculpted marks, sparse fine grain. Snow highlight #DCE5DE, midtone #A9BDC0, shadow #607D89, no pure white. Painterly semi-realistic preindustrial fantasy, desaturated cool grey and slate-blue. Opposite edges must tile without visible seams. Deliver opaque square texture. Save the source as /workspace/Ice-Age-Lord/assets/source/terrain/snow-calibration.png if a workspace file can be returned.
